dataset: Song S., Baek J., Seo S., Scientific Data 12 (2025), 'A Comprehensive Dataset of Lipid Nanoparticle Compositions and Properties for Nucleic Acid Delivery' (LNP Atlas); data deposit Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.17243733 (CC BY 4.0), file LNP_Atlas_DB_202509_v1.csv; a peer-reviewed literature-compiled dataset (63 source papers), not a single-laboratory measurement set
intake_basis: header, row count (1092), non-empty counts per column, cell-format counts of the size column (plain / with uncertainty / range / empty), level counts of the lipid, target_type, year and paper columns, keyword counts of synthesis_info; the paper_doi list was read for the independence check; no size value was read before this binding was written

columns.native: constructed by the custodian from protocol rule (2): frac_ionizable, frac_helper, frac_sterol, frac_peg (lipid_molar_ratio parsed as the first four colon-separated numbers, normalised to sum 1), one-hot of ionizable_lipid / helper_lipid / peg_lipid / sterol_lipid (levels defined on the union of development and sealed inputs; empty string is a level), one-hot of target_type, and five method keyword flags (herringbone; t-junction; nanoassemblr or ignite; pipette or hand; ethanol injection); the concrete column list is written to custodian_manifest.json
columns.dimensionless_note: no flow or dimensionless inputs exist; H-C is not evaluable on this dataset
columns.target: target (= particle_size_nm_std parsed by protocol rule (1): plain number or 'a +/- b' -> a; ranges and other text dropped and counted; empty dropped and counted)

groups.S0: row-random 80/20 inside the development set, seeds 0-14
groups.S1: s1_group = source paper (paper_doi, normalised); dev-ref grouping and GroupShuffleSplit 80/20 cells
groups.S3: s3_group = source paper (paper_doi, normalised; 'Custom lipid' and other catch-all names stay as ordinary levels)
groups.S4: s4_group = preparation class from synthesis_info keywords: 'microfluidic' if any of microfluidic / nanoassemblr / herringbone / t-junction / ignite occurs, else 'non_microfluidic'; the minority class is sealed entirely as the S4 tier, the main table (S2/S3 sealing and development) is the majority class

sealing_rules.S2: among s2_group levels of the main table with >= 10 target rows, excluding every level that attains the maximum count, choose the level whose count is closest to the median of the eligible counts; ties -> lexicographically smallest level name
sealing_rules.S3: same rule on s3_group levels of the main table; if the chosen level's rows intersect the S2 sealed rows, take the next candidate; if none remains, S3 is not sealed
sealing_rules.S4: minority preparation class sealed entirely (protocol section 3)

parsing_rules.size: protocol rule (1); counts per cell kind written to the manifest
parsing_rules.ratio: protocol rule (2); rows with fewer than four numbers or a non-positive sum are dropped and counted
parsing_rules.doi: lower-cased, 'https://doi.org/' and 'http://dx.doi.org/' prefixes removed; empty -> '(no doi)'

hard_bound_note: no physical upper bound for a reported hydrodynamic diameter; bounded model = log-target MLP, unbounded = raw-scale MLP (H-B B1 only)
anchor_note: no literature correlation applies to literature-reported LNP sizes; H-B B2 not evaluable

tolerance.absolute_rule: 0.10 x development-set median target (computed by the custodian from development labels and written to the devdiag file)

target_scale_rule: development labels only: log target if max/min > 10 or skewness > 2, else raw scale
